decisions.md ruling 15 (OWNER, in-game 2026-08-26): the Electro Dragon deals 192 @L11, not the 267 both wiki pages publish. Three independent supports: (a) the Evolution page's own `late_dmg_11 = 64` -- its level table's 'Damage after 5 chains' column -- reproduces exactly from 192 through its two dated chain nerfs (192 x 0.67 on 8/1/2025 'damage after the first 3 chains -33%' x 0.50 on 2/3/2026 'chain damage -50%' = 64.3 -> 64) and NOT from 267 (-> 89); (b) webcache/Electro_Dragon.rev436720.wikitext publishes `dmg_11 | 192`, so 192 is this page's own older value rather than an unsourced reading; (c) the page's stat block has drifted far past what its History documents -- hp_11 949 -> 1383 -> 1451 (+53%) against History entries recording only two +5% buffs. The competing reading (267 live, late_dmg_11 stale) is recorded in conflicts.md, not discarded. dps is the quotient 192/2.3 because build_spec rebuilds per-hit damage as dps * hit_speed
